annotations.text:
Dark-first re-skin of Tempo, drafted against the real layouts.

Near-black neutrals instead of the Material 3 baseline purple, Tempo's own coral #f24b6a as the one accent, rounded artwork, and a mini-player that lifts off the bottom edge.

Same three-tab navigation, same fragments, same ViewPager2s underneath - this is a re-skin plus a re-layout, not a re-architecture.

Two things left open:

Light theme - the palette is specced on the System page, but no light screens are drawn yet.

The album header gradient is hand-picked here. In the app it would come from Palette on the loaded cover, with the neutral background as the fallback.
